# Karan Wakhare

> Computer engineering student and developer in Pune building AI tools and full-stack apps.

## Builds

- [Grocer](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/grocer): WhatsApp grocery assistant that verifies orders against live Swiggy Instamart inventory and auto-fixes out-of-stock items.
- [Outpost](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/outpost): Inventory replenishment decision engine for quick-commerce dark stores.
- [Git for Prompts](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/git-for-prompts): Git-style version control for AI prompts with commit histories, token diffing, and multi-model evals.
- [Beam](https://karan30.vercel.app/builds/beam): Offline Windows 11 capsule with live music controls, a file shelf, a countdown, and a calendar.
